title: OPP officers cleared in fatal shootout
article: Two Ontario Provincial Police officers who shot and killed a Quebec gunman linked to bikers during a traffic stop last month have been cleared of any wrongdoing.

Ontario's Special Investigations Unit concluded yesterday the officers were justified in using lethal force when they shot and killed career criminal Daniel Lamer, 37, on Highway 401 near Morrisburg, Ont., about 80 kilometres from the Ontario-Quebec border.

"The officers shot at Mr. Lamer with the very reasonably held belief that shooting was necessary in order to preserve their own lives or the lives of their colleagues," said SIU director Peter Tinsley.

Constable Dan Brisson was wounded by a gunshot to the back of the head during the March 10 gunfight that erupted after a Pontiac Sunfire was stopped for speeding. The driver, Marc Bouffard, 27, faces 19 charges, including attempted murder.
